links.comparator_used: Baseline prompt (unmodified question) to the same LLM (Gemini 3.1 Pro), versus the bundled CRAFT prompt with role among its elements; the role element was not tested alone
links.outcome: Clinical utility (5-point Delphi expert rating) and safety classification
links.effect: Clinical utility rose from 3.99 to 4.68 in English and from 4.21 to 4.66 in Traditional Chinese (both P<.001). English safe responses went from 23/25 to 25/25 (exact McNemar P=.50, descriptive only). Traditional Chinese stayed at 25/25 safe.
links.tradeoff: Exploratory within-sample comparison. The safety change was not statistically significant. Understandability was not reduced.
links.quote: Applying the CRAFT prompt to Gemini 3.1 Pro significantly improved clinical utility across both languages (English: mean 4.68, SD 0.18, P<.001; Traditional Chinese: 4.66, SD 0.23, P<.001).
